must: TV mounting is the primary service (~80% of demand)
No database, no deploy — local development only
avoid: Quiz funnels and aggressive lead-gen popups
Rainbow gradients and cheap discount banners

decisions.rationale: Unobtrusive, simple, technological and expensive. Rejected liquid glass and competitor quiz funnels.

decisions.choice: Fullscreen photo hero with split floating nav and bottom-left copy
decisions.rationale: Centered circular wordmark plus a compact pill for sections. Copy stays in a narrow left column so the install photography remains the visual. Inter for Cyrillic-capable product type; amber accent from the existing brand, not a blue SaaS palette. Floating surfaces are off-white, not glass.

decisions.choice: Homepage SERVICES is one wide photo strip with diagonal seams
decisions.rationale: Client reference: a bold SERVICES word behind three large photo cards that read as a single rounded block. The word is 32px. Numbers, names, and arrow buttons sit on the photos. Services and Contact in the nav scroll to the homepage section and the footer.

decisions.choice: TV Mounting uses the shared header in its white scrolled state from the start
decisions.rationale: Other pages keep the transparent header over the hero. On TV Mounting the same header is white immediately, and the photo reel starts below it.

decisions.choice: Footer keeps its content and uses a deep navy gradient with edge glow
decisions.rationale: Solid black becomes a charcoal-navy field with a soft #2580cd glow, thin arcs, and a dotted pattern only at the edges. Links, type, spacing, and the divider stay as they were.

decisions.choice: Deals signup sits inside the FAQ blue band as a darkened interior panel
decisions.rationale: FAQ keeps its centered list and blue atmosphere. The signup form continues that band inside a 28px-radius photo block, inset from the container, with Deals in #2580cd.

decisions.choice: Compact applications table with status and delete
decisions.rationale: Admin applications stay a light table in the existing off-white and blue palette. Date range and paging remain. Status, copy, and delete are inline. No search, filters by status, or details drawer.

decisions.choice: Electrician page uses a 2-row icon card grid, worker description, quiz timeline, and a small deals card
decisions.rationale: Only the Electrician service page changes. Offer carousel cards are removed. Six service icons sit under the title in two rows of white bordered cards, each with the icon and a short caption, and open Book Now with that service selected. The homepage worker cutout sits on the opposite side from the direction he faces. What happens after the quiz is four steps: a vertical timeline on small screens and four cards on desktop. The photos block becomes a 600 by 350 card with its title and a text block underneath. The FAQ reuses the homepage template with its own questions. A reusable Areas block sits last: a small Google map on the left and San Diego, Orange County, and Los Angeles on the right. The chosen region and city are stored in localStorage and move the map.

decisions.choice: Electrical and Handyman reuse the TV Mounting photo reel, light band, and gallery cards
decisions.rationale: Both pages open with the same header reel and white header. The first section is three white cards with a photo carousel, a visible title, and a Show more control for the description. The photos block is one large carousel with BOOK NOW underneath. Get Quote copy on buttons and the footer is BOOK NOW.
